desc: Implement O(N^2) recurrence and brute-force checker.
Implement fast corner-recurrence solver (CDQ/NTT, corner compression, constant-d/zero-suffix FPS).
Fix sample-1 runtime error and make all three samples pass.
Validate fast solver on small/medium cases (exhaustive N<=5, random N<=7 vs brute, N up to 2000 vs O(N^2) recurrence) and debug any mismatches.

Benchmark N=2e5 worst cases (alternating, all-B-then-W, random valid, and adversarial inc patterns like 2,0,2,0,... ending W) and tune CDQ/NTT thresholds or add further special-case optimizations until within time; finalize stdin/stdout code.
